articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring substantially improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a unified architecture that merges previous o-series deliberative capabilities into a single model. Benchmarks show significant gains on PhD-level science QA and competitive coding, though independent evaluators note diminishing returns on certain narrow tasks compared to GPT-4o fine-tunes.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Tops Multi-Agent Coordination Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra with a focus on multi-agent orchestration, allowing a single model to spawn and manage subordinate agent threads for complex workflows. The system demonstrated state-of-the-art performance on SWE-Bench and real-world enterprise automation tasks, intensifying competition with OpenAI and Anthropic in the agentic AI space.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Fremont Factory
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has started performing material handling and quality inspection tasks alongside human workers at the Fremont plant. The new revision features improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and an on-device vision-language model enabling natural-language task instructions, though Tesla says fully autonomous operation remains limited to structured environments.

articles.title: Figure and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment Across Three European Plants
articles.summary: Figure AI announced an expanded partnership with BMW to deploy its Figure 02 humanoid robots at three additional European manufacturing facilities following a successful pilot in Spartanburg. The robots handle bin-picking, part insertion, and inter-station logistics, with Figure citing a 40% reduction in per-unit integration cost compared to first-generation deployments.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Sandboxing for Enterprise Agentic Workflows
articles.summary: Anthropic rolled out a new sandboxed execution environment for Claude's tool-use capabilities, allowing enterprise customers to grant agents controlled access to internal APIs, databases, and file systems with fine-grained permission policies. The feature includes an audit-log system and human-in-the-loop checkpoints, addressing a key barrier to production deployment of autonomous AI agents in regulated industries.

articles.title: ASML Reports Record EUV High-NA Orders as Chip Firms Race Toward 1.4nm Nodes
articles.summary: ASML disclosed a record quarterly backlog for its next-generation High-NA EUV lithography systems, driven by orders from TSMC, Intel, and Samsung targeting sub-2nm process nodes expected in 2027-2028. The machines, priced at over $380 million each, are critical to sustaining Moore's Law scaling and meeting surging AI chip demand.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins with First Compliance Audits of Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The EU AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits of major foundation model providers under the AI Act's general-purpose AI provisions, which took full effect in June 2026. Companies including OpenAI, Google, and Meta are required to demonstrate systemic risk assessments, red-teaming documentation, and energy consumption disclosures, setting a global precedent for AI governance enforcement.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform for Construction and Logistics
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics, backed by Hyundai, announced the commercial availability of its electric Atlas humanoid platform tailored for construction site logistics and warehouse operations. The system integrates a reinforcement-learning locomotion stack with LLM-based task planning, enabling it to navigate unstructured terrain while interpreting high-level natural-language job orders from site managers.
